subject: Align: BYOK/KMS evidence path & retention policy decisions
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Align: BYOK/KMS evidence path & retention policy decisions

All —

Quick context: ClearHealth (security@clearhealth.com) has asked for a packaged set of evidence proving BYOK usage, KMS rotation logs, and a retention carveout for a subset of records tied to their clinical workflows. Procurement is waiting on a short decision memo.

Asks:
- Can Product/Infra confirm the minimal evidence set we can deliver without expanding retention for other customers? (audit logs, key rotation proof, key policy snapshots)
- Legal/Sales needs a one-page decision memo to move procurement along; Ben, can you own that if we agree scope?
- Ops: what's the tentative timeline to produce the artifacts and any manual steps required?

I attached a rough evidence checklist to start. Proposal: 30-min sync tomorrow to land on a final scope and whether we accept a temporary retention carveout with compensating controls.

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Security PM, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai

Attachments: BYOK_evidence_requirements_v1.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Align: BYOK/KMS evidence path & retention policy decisions

Soojin —

Thanks for the summary. Quick notes from product:
- The evidence list looks fine as a starting point. We need to be explicit about log retention windows for the rotation proof (we currently retain detailed rotation logs for 90 days in the analytics cluster).
- If ClearHealth needs 12-month retention for rotation or audit trails, that's a product/ops change and should be scoped as a temporary carveout + ticketed implementation.

I've attached a retention_matrix.xlsx that maps our existing buckets to likely ask levels (90d, 1yr, 3yr). For the sync we should: agree on minimum acceptable proof, decide whether to extend retention, and decide whether evidence will be delivered as a static package (zip + attestation) or via a live access channel.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior PM, Product Security
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: retention_matrix.xlsx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Align: BYOK/KMS evidence path & retention policy decisions

Folks —

Technical notes from infra:
- Practical evidence set we can produce today without infra changes: key metadata snapshot (key IDs, creation timestamps), last rotation events (timestamp + operator ID), and a signed snapshot of key policies. Those artifacts are exportable from KMS but rotation full audit traces are currently short-lived (90d) as Marissa noted.
- If ClearHealth requires >90d rotation history, options are: (A) produce an on-demand export of archival logs (manual, ~3-5 business days), (B) temporarily increase rotation log retention for their tenant (needs ops change and SLA carveout), or (C) provide attestation + sampled proof with a limited acceptance window.
- BYOK flow: we will need a short runbook for key import confirmation and proof collection. I created a Jira ticket SUP-4521 to track runbook + export work.

Proposed deliverables for decision memo:
1) Evidence components (list)
2) Timeline & manual steps if choosing archival export
3) Risk/controls if we accept sampled proof vs full archival logs

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Staff Infra Engineer
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

Links: JIRA:SUP-4521, https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/1a2B_BYOK-evidence
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, security@clearhealth.com, procurement@clearhealth.com
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Align: BYOK/KMS evidence path & retention policy decisions

Soojin / team —

From Sales: ClearHealth is on a tight procurement window. They asked for a short decision memo and a plan to get to “signed” evidence. If product/infra can confirm the minimal artifact set and timeline (manual export is OK), I’ll draft the memo and the mutual action plan.

Ask from my side: please call out any non-standard contract language (SLA exceptions, retention carveouts, extra security attestations) so Legal can pre-clear. I can also loop procurement contacts.

I propose we offer:
- Delivery option A (fast): manual archival export + attestation in 3–5 business days for a one-off fee.
- Delivery option B (longer): infra change to extend retention for tenant for 90→365 days, timed with an infra release (4–6 weeks) and an SLA addendum.

If you want, I’ll send the initial decision memo draft now and mark placeholders for timelines.

Ben Carter
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

On Mon, Aug 16, 2027 at 09:00 Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Soo- quick ping: are we able to support an on-demand export if they pay for expedited delivery?
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Align: BYOK/KMS evidence path & retention policy decisions

Team —

After reviewing the options, leadership is comfortable approving a temporary, documented retention carveout for ClearHealth provided we attach compensating controls and a sunset plan. Action items:
1) Soojin/Marissa/Karthik: produce the evidence pack template + runbook (what we will hand over, how it is signed, and how we attest). Due EOD Fri (2027-08-20).
2) Ben: draft the 1-page decision memo and the mutual action plan for ClearHealth procurement; include pricing for expedited manual export and the timeline for infra change. Draft due Wed EOD (2027-08-18).
3) Karthik/Infra: open the internal change ticket for retention increase if they pick option B and include rollback steps; mark as prep-only until procurement signs. Reference SUP-4521.
4) All: include a fallback where ClearHealth gets a sampled attestation within 48 hours if expedited archive fails.

I will escalate to Legal only if the memo flags non-standard language. Keep me posted in the Jira ticket and upload final artifacts to the Drive link.

Jonas Weber
Director, Security & Compliance
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
